init.description: Run init.ps1 to verify environment before starting work
init.template: Execute ./init.ps1 and report if all checks pass. If it fails, do NOT proceed until issues are resolved.

next.description: Start the next pending SDD feature
next.template: Read harness/feature_list.json, find the first feature with status 'pending' and 'sdd': true, then launch the spec-author agent via the sdd-workflow skill to begin Spec Driven Development.
